meta.title: Fresh Egyptian Fish for EU Importers & Wholesalers
meta.description: From 4 Nov 2026, Egyptian farmed fish can be sold in all 27 EU countries. AZAFCO supplies fresh tilapia, sea bass and mullet at 0–4°C. Start a partnership.

hero.badge: The EU market opens on 4 November 2026
hero.title: Fresh Fish from Egypt for EU Importers and Wholesalers
hero.subtitle: AZAFCO has exported fresh fish from Kafr El Sheikh since 2008. As the European Union opens to Egyptian farmed fish, we are taking enquiries from importers, wholesalers and distributors across Europe.

opening.title: What changes on 4 November 2026
opening.p1: From 4 November 2026, Egyptian farmed fish can be exported to all 27 member states of the European Union. For EU buyers, that opens a new source of fresh fish: Egypt ranks first in Africa and sixth in the world in aquaculture.
opening.p2: Our factory is in Kafr El Sheikh, the governorate that produces nearly half of Egypt's fish. We work with this supply every day, and we are ready to talk to EU buyers about species, sizes and volumes.

about.title: Who we are
about.p1: AZAFCO International for Investment and Development is an Egyptian B2B fresh fish exporter, founded in 2008 in Kafr El Sheikh. We supply distributors, wholesalers, restaurants and hotels, with a capacity of more than 2,500 tonnes a month and more than 500 clients.
about.p2: Europe is not new to us: we first shipped to Spain in 2018. Today our fish goes to buyers across the Gulf and the Middle East, and our export team is available around the clock.

species.title: Species we supply
species.subtitle: Fresh fish graded to the sizes your market needs. Custom sizes are available for every species.
species.note: Tell us which species and sizes you need, and we will confirm what we can supply to your EU destination.

process.title: How ordering works
process.subtitle: Four steps from your first enquiry to delivery

steps.title: Send your enquiry
steps.desc: Tell us the species, sizes, volumes and destination you need, through our contact page, WhatsApp or email.

steps.title: Agree the details
steps.desc: We confirm availability, sizing, packing and the export documents your shipment needs, then send you a written offer.

steps.title: Grading and packing
steps.desc: Your fish is graded to your sizes and packed in EPS boxes, kept at 0–4°C throughout.

steps.title: Shipping
steps.desc: Your order travels chilled by air freight, and our team stays in touch with you until it arrives.

shipping.title: Cold chain and packing
shipping.subtitle: Fresh fish needs care at every stage, from our factory to your warehouse

items.title: 0–4°C cold chain
items.desc: Temperature controlled from catch to delivery.

items.title: EPS boxes
items.desc: Fish is packed in insulated EPS boxes for export.

items.title: Air freight
items.desc: We ship chilled fish by air to destinations worldwide.

items.title: Year-round supply
items.desc: Our species are available all year, with sizes and order volumes tailored to you.

quality.title: Quality and certifications
quality.text: Food safety and quality management are central to how we work, built on ISO and HACCP systems. Our certificates page has the details, and you can ask us for current copies when you enquire.

cta.title: Buying fresh fish for the EU market?
cta.subtitle: Tell us what you need. Our export team will reply with availability and a written offer.
